cases.title: Sales settings: admin sets the discount approval threshold to 15% (saved in the workspace settings)
Quote above the limit: status change to Sent is refused with a message; DB status stays DRAFT
Quote modal shows "Approval needed"; owner submits with a note -> "Awaiting approval", DB PENDING, manager notified
Pipeline -> Discount approvals: manager sees the quote under "Awaiting my approval"; Reject is disabled without a reason; Approve -> DB APPROVED
Deal page shows the "Discount approved" badge and the quote can now be sent
Manager rejects from the quote modal with a reason; owner sees "Discount rejected" with the reason
